recent_posts.title: PowerToys .99 | Grab, Move, and Command Palette Just Got Better
What's new in PowerToys 0.98
recent_posts.summary: PowerToys 0.98 introduces several notable features: a Command Palette dock for pinning favorite commands to a screen edge, a rebuilt Keyboard Manager editor using WinUI and C# with a unified view for key and shortcut remaps, individual toggle switches for remappings, and a rewritten cursor wrap engine with better multi-monitor support. Always on Top gains a right-click title bar option and transparency controls. Other improvements include ZoomIt's new video editor, New+ hiding the default new menu, and various bug fixes across tools. The release is available via in-app update, WinGet, Microsoft Store, or GitHub.

recent_posts.title: Native Windows Integrations in Electron apps with the winapp CLI
recent_posts.summary: The WinApp CLI is a new command-line tool that simplifies Windows API integration for Electron and other desktop applications. It automates environment setup, manifest generation, certificate creation, SDK installation, and packaging. The tool includes an npm package for Electron developers that enables native add-on creation in C# or C++, provides debug package identity for development (eliminating the need to fully package apps for testing), and supports building MSIX packages for distribution. Developers can access Windows-specific features like notifications, shell integrations, and AI APIs while maintaining their normal development workflow.

recent_posts.title: Manus + MCP on Windows: Build a Website from Local Files in Minutes
recent_posts.summary: Manus is an AI agent that automates website creation by accessing local files through a file explorer connector, selecting appropriate images, and deploying the site via Windows 365 for agents. The system provides an audit trail of tasks and reduces website building time from days to minutes through natural language instructions.

recent_posts.title: Expense Management using Dynamics 365 agent in M365 Copilot
recent_posts.summary: Dynamics 365 agents integrated with M365 Copilot can automate expense management workflows by processing natural language requests. Instead of manually uploading receipts and clicking through multiple steps over 30+ minutes, users can simply ask the agent to gather receipts from a specific trip and generate expense reports. The agent autonomously locates relevant files, requests user consent, and completes the submission process.

recent_posts.title: Claude + MCP on Windows: From Local Files to Executive Summary in Minutes
recent_posts.summary: Claude Desktop now supports a file explorer connector on Windows through MCP (Model Context Protocol), enabling automated document aggregation and summarization. The demo shows how Claude can search across multiple local folders, gather scattered project documents (meeting notes, spreadsheets, status updates), and generate executive summaries with user consent, reducing manual work from hours to minutes.
